text:
The Agent2Agent protocol just moved to a neutral foundation, and it changes how you should be building.

Google handed A2A to the Agentic AI Foundation, where Anthropic's MCP already lives. Two open standards doing two different jobs: MCP connects one agent to your tools and data. A2A lets agents from different frameworks and different vendors discover each other, agree on what they can do, and hand a task across.

Version 1.0 shipped in March. More than 150 organizations already support it. Discovery runs on Agent Cards - a signed JSON file that describes what your agent does and how to reach it.

The practical read: stop hand-writing custom glue between every agent you build.

The bigger signal is simpler. One model was never the plan. The stack is becoming a network.
